summary: Iteration 268: AI Auto-Learning Insights fully tested. All 27 tests passed. The insights endpoint correctly detects repeated win/loss patterns in owner override history grouped by day-of-week and generates actionable recommendations in Turkish.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/rates/grid/insights/{property_id}?lookback_days=N correctly returns insights[] grouped by pattern type
Pattern 1 (warning - repeated_loss_pattern): Correctly detects same DOW ≥2 times where owner > AI by ≥10% AND occupancy < 30%
Pattern 2 (success - consistent_win_pattern): Correctly detects same DOW ≥3 times where owner > AI AND bookings > 0 AND occupancy ≥ 30%
Pattern 3 (info - min_rate_streak): Correctly detects 5+ days in last 14 days hitting min_rate
Insights correctly sorted by severity (warning < success < info)
Each insight has required fields: id, severity, type, message (Turkish), recommendation {action, label, dow, target_offset_pct}, evidence
POST /api/rates/grid/insights/apply correctly returns suggested_dates[] with target_pms_override = ai_rate * (1 + offset_pct/100)
applied_count is 0 (intentional dry-run — owner reviews before submit)
Apply endpoint correctly limits to 90 days in the future
Auth required (admin/manager only) - 401/403 returned without valid token or with housekeeper role
DOW_NAMES_TR Turkish labels correctly used: Pazartesi, Salı, Çarşamba, Perşembe, Cuma, Cumartesi, Pazar
seed_data_creation: Used existing aldgate-flats test data with 3 Mondays + 2 Thu + 2 Fri at £280 vs ~£75 AI with low occupancy
